tickets.text: The trigger buys the daily close at the 52-week closing high, the breakout close Turtle Soup fades (C3). Contraction is unproven: bar_range_history NOT_SERVED. I would buy the hourly hook after a dip, h1_close_above:bar_high. Not my set-up.

A daily close above the 52-week closing high is a breakout-close buy. I read a test of the just-broken high with D swing HH/HL, timed on the hour (C3, C17). W swing LH/LL keeps it small. I would clear on h1_close_above:bar_high on the test.

No set-up of mine: D swing LH but HL and the close is above the last swing high, so a daily breakout close is not a test, a retracement or proven contraction (R1, R5). I would clear on a retest of the broken pivot with an hourly hook as the trigger.

The trigger is the daily breakout close. I read a retracement after a break, D and W swing HH/HL, and act on the hourly close above yesterday's high (C2, C3). I would clear on h1_close_above:bar_high on the pullback, not the daily close at the high.

Extended on thin volume, W 20.5% above last swing high. A daily breakout-close trigger is no test, retracement or contraction: a late buy of a climax-shaped move (C11, C19). I would clear on a retracement to a swing low with an hourly hook as trigger.

Extended, H1 swing HH but LL, no dip to buy. A daily breakout-close trigger fits none of my four families (R1) and is the entry Turtle Soup fades (C3). I would clear on a pullback retest with an hourly hook instead of the breakout close.

Extended, D close 3.4% above the last swing high. A daily breakout-close trigger is no test or retracement, and day_vol 0.98 shows no participation (R1, R5). I would clear on a retest of the swing high with an hourly hook, not a breakout close.
